title: Conditional sign memory in heartbeat intervals: an exploratory cross-database prediction test
abstract: Adding median five-minute ternary sign conditional mutual information reduced external CHF-versus-normal Brier loss by 0.01485 (added-minus-baseline -0.01485, joint record bootstrap 95% [-0.03151, -0.00398]) beyond time-domain HRV and first-order sign summaries. Strong timing sensitivity and better performance after target sign destruction prevent attributing the gain specifically to physiological memory.
